pages.title: Helpdesk Guide
pages.content:
# Helpdesk Guide

This workspace coordinates customer support. Tickets are the customer-facing work items; internal follow-up stays on the ticket's linked items.

## Queue

- New tickets start in **Open**.
- Pick up work by moving a ticket to **In Progress**.
- **Pending** means you are waiting on the requester.
- **Resolved** closes the support loop; **Closed** archives it.

## Intake

Email intake, request types, and portal settings are configured on the workspace's support channel.
